title: Minutes Until All Oranges Rot
statement: You are given a grid of integers representing a box of oranges: 0 = empty cell, 1 = a fresh orange, 2 = a rotten orange, given as a list of lists grid[row][col]. Every minute, any fresh orange that is horizontally or vertically adjacent to a rotten orange becomes rotten. Return the minimum number of minutes that must elapse until no cell has a fresh orange. If this is impossible (some fresh orange can never rot), return -1.
hints: Think of every rotten orange as a source; this is a multi-source shortest-path/BFS-levels problem.
Push all initially rotten oranges into a BFS queue at time 0, then expand outward one minute (one BFS layer) at a time.
Track how many fresh oranges you infect; after BFS completes, if any fresh orange was never reached, return -1, otherwise return the max time recorded.
